faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Junior Resident (Dental).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 33 years (as on 1 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST As per rules, OBC/PH As per rules (OBC certificate issued from Govt. NCT of Delhi only).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 10 of Pay Matrix plus usual allowances under the Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Valid dental degree from a recognized institution, registration with Delhi Dental Council, and internship completed in the last two years reckoned from 18-11-2026.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Dental Council. Internship must be completed for last two year reckoned from 18-11-2026. Only OBC certificate issued from Govt. NCT of Delhi will be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening written test. Interview of candidates who qualify in the written test. Screening written test for all candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc basis for 44 days tenure, extendable up to one year, subject to terms and conditions. Candidates who already completed one year of Junior Residency, if allowed, will be offered residency for a further six months or as per Health & FW Department terms.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital, Khichripur, Delhi.
